newsitem.title: USA: Issing -- would oppose early Euro link to dlr, yen.
newsitem.headline: Issing -- would oppose early Euro link to dlr, yen.

text.p: Bundesbank Chief Economist Otmar Issing said Monday he would be strictly opposed to any proposal that the planned single European currency should be linked to the dollar and yen in a global exchange rate system in the early years after its creation.
Responding to a question at a business forum, Issing said "I would be strictly opposed to that, especially in the first years of the Euro."
Issing said any link of that type would be dangerous as monetary authorities would have to adjust to the existence of the new currency in the first few years after its creation in 1999.
"We do not know how the authorities will behave with regard to distribution of reserves," he said.
"Such an arrangement would also increase the burden for doing sound monetary policy in Europe," he added.
